title: 雪山 2.0 抽蓄水電工程
summary: 雪山 2.0 以隧道連接雪山計畫既有的坦坦加拉與塔爾賓戈水庫，在地下約 800 m 興建 2,200 MW 的抽蓄電站，可儲存約 350 GWh；課程定量分析長時儲能的意義、長隧道的水頭損失與潛盾機受困的地質風險，以及極深地下廠房的設計。
summaryEn: Snowy 2.0 links the existing Tantangara and Talbingo reservoirs of the Snowy Scheme by tunnel and builds a 2,200 MW pumped-storage station about 800 m underground, storing about 350 GWh; the course quantifies what long-duration storage means, head loss in long tunnels and the ground risk that trapped a tunnel boring machine, and design of a very deep powerhouse.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 27 km 隧道連接兩座既有水庫的 2,200 MW、長時儲能抽蓄工程
v30FocusEn: A 2,200 MW long-duration pumped-hydro project linking two existing reservoirs through 27 km of tunnels

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：雪山 2.0 抽蓄水電工程
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Snowy 2.0 Pumped Hydro Project
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「上池蓄能量」與「長時儲能與電池的分工」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Long-duration storage alongside batteries": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「上池蓄能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" is correct?
options: 抽蓄電站把電能轉成上池水體的位能：可用蓄能量與上池有效容積及平均水頭成正比。
抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。
儲能電站只要功率夠大就好，能存幾小時並不重要。
optionsEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head.
Storage energy of a pumped plant is set by unit capacity; bigger units store more.
A storage plant only needs enough power; how many hours it stores hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 抽蓄電站把電能轉成上池水體的位能：可用蓄能量與上池有效容積及平均水頭成正比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「上池蓄能量」如何決定「雪山 2.0 抽蓄水電工程」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Snowy 2.0 Pumped Hydro Project”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 抽蓄電站把電能轉成上池水體的位能：可用蓄能量與上池有效容積及平均水頭成正比。與電池不同，功率（由機組與水道決定）和能量（由水庫容積決定）可以分開設計，因此同樣的機組可以搭配數小時到數十小時的蓄能。上池水位變動時水頭跟著改變，機組必須在整個水頭變幅內都能穩定發電與抽水。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head. Unlike a battery, power, set by the units and waterways, and energy, set by reservoir volume, can be designed separately, so the same units can be paired with a few hours to tens of hours of storage. As the upper level changes so does the head, and the units must generate and pump stably across the whole head range. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：裝置容量 2,200 MW，共 6 台可逆式機組，其中 3 台為變速機組
steps.observationEn: Project file: Installed capacity is 2,200 MW in six reversible units, three of them variable-speed
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Storage energy of a pumped plant is set by unit capacity; bigger units store more." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「上池蓄能量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Energy stored in the upper reservoir”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir

knowledge.textEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head. Unlike a battery, power, set by the units and waterways, and energy, set by reservoir volume, can be designed separately, so the same units can be paired with a few hours to tens of hours of storage. As the upper level changes so does the head, and the units must generate and pump stably across the whole head range.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 裝置容量 2,200 MW，共 6 台可逆式機組，其中 3 台為變速機組
knowledge.textEn: Installed capacity is 2,200 MW in six reversible units, three of them variable-speed

quiz.question: 依「上池蓄能量」的模型 E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²，上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹² for "Energy stored in the upper reservoir", which value is closest to the energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)?
options: 200 GWh
400 GWh
optionsEn: 200 GWh
400 GWh
quiz.explanation: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Vu = 240 hm³、H = 680 m、η = 0.9，得 400 GWh（上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Vu = 240 hm³, H = 680 m, η = 0.9 the result is 400 GWh (energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「上池蓄能量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Vu = 240 hm³、H = 680 m、η = 0.9，得 400 GWh（上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Vu 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Vu = 240 hm³, H = 680 m, η = 0.9 the result is 400 GWh (energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Vu by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Vu 增加 10% 時，結果變為 440 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Vu by 10% changes the result to 440 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 400 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Vu 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 400 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Vu with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Vu = 240 hm³、H = 680 m、η = 0.9，得 400 GWh（上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量）。
knowledge.textEn: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Vu = 240 hm³, H = 680 m, η = 0.9 the result is 400 GWh (energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Vu 增加 10% 時，結果變為 440 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Vu by 10% changes the result to 440 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「上池蓄能量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy stored in the upper reservoir"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
岩石很堅硬，地下洞室挖好後不需要支撐也不會變形。
以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Rock is hard, so an underground cavern needs no support and does not deform once excavated.

Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters.
quiz.explanation: 以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「上池蓄能量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要分別寫明額定功率、可用蓄能量與對應的水位範圍，並註明效率與水頭的計算基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specifications should state rated power, usable energy and the corresponding level range separately, with the efficiency and head basis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書要分別寫明額定功率、可用蓄能量與對應的水位範圍，並註明效率與水頭的計算基準。
knowledge.textEn: Specifications should state rated power, usable energy and the corresponding level range separately, with the efficiency and head basis.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60193 水輪機、蓄能泵與水泵水輪機模型驗收試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60193 Hydraulic turbines, storage pumps and pump-turbines – Model acceptance tests. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「上池蓄能量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
儲能電站只要功率夠大就好，能存幾小時並不重要。
optionsEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
A storage plant only needs enough power; how many hours it stores hardly matters.
quiz.explanation: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「上池蓄能量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「雪山 2.0 抽蓄水電工程」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Snowy 2.0 Pumped Hydro Project”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：上池水位變動時水頭跟著改變，機組必須在整個水頭變幅內都能穩定發電與抽水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: As the upper level changes so does the head, and the units must generate and pump stably across the whole head range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Storage energy of a pumped plant is set by unit capacity; bigger units store more." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。
knowledge.textEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「長時儲能與電池的分工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-duration storage alongside batteries" is correct?
options: 儲能電站只要功率夠大就好，能存幾小時並不重要。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
澳洲的電網級電池多半只能滿載放電兩到四小時，適合處理每天傍晚的尖峰與秒級的頻率控制；但當連續幾天無風又陰天時，需要的是能持續放電數日的儲能。
optionsEn: A storage plant only needs enough power; how many hours it stores hardly matters.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.

Most grid batteries in Australia discharge at full power for only two to four hours, suited to the evening peak and second-scale frequency control, but when several calm, cloudy days follow one another the need is for storage that can discharge for days.
quiz.explanation: 澳洲的電網級電池多半只能滿載放電兩到四小時，適合處理每天傍晚的尖峰與秒級的頻率控制；但當連續幾天無風又陰天時，需要的是能持續放電數日的儲能。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Most grid batteries in Australia discharge at full power for only two to four hours, suited to the evening peak and second-scale frequency control, but when several calm, cloudy days follow one another the need is for storage that can discharge for days. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長時儲能與電池的分工：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-duration storage alongside batteries: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「長時儲能與電池的分工」如何決定「雪山 2.0 抽蓄水電工程」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-duration storage alongside batteries” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Snowy 2.0 Pumped Hydro Project”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 澳洲的電網級電池多半只能滿載放電兩到四小時，適合處理每天傍晚的尖峰與秒級的頻率控制；但當連續幾天無風又陰天時，需要的是能持續放電數日的儲能。雪山 2.0 的能量功率比約 160 小時，與電池相差近兩個數量級：它的功率成本很高（隧道、機組），但每多存一度電的邊際成本極低，因為上下池本來就存在。兩者在電力系統中的角色互補而非競爭。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Most grid batteries in Australia discharge at full power for only two to four hours, suited to the evening peak and second-scale frequency control, but when several calm, cloudy days follow one another the need is for storage that can discharge for days. Snowy 2.0 has an energy-to-power ratio of about 160 hours, nearly two orders of magnitude beyond batteries: its power cost is high, tunnels and machines, yet the marginal cost of each extra kilowatt-hour stored is very low because the reservoirs already exist. The two play complementary, not competing, roles. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：可儲存約 350 GWh，相當於滿載發電約 160 小時
steps.observationEn: Project file: It stores about 350 GWh, about 160 hours at full output
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲能電站只要功率夠大就好，能存幾小時並不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A storage plant only needs enough power; how many hours it stores hardly matters." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「長時儲能與電池的分工」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Long-duration storage alongside batteries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The two play complementary, not competing, roles.

quiz.question: 依「長時儲能與電池的分工」的模型 t = E / P，350 GWh 蓄能量在 2,200 MW 下的連續放電時數最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = E / P for "Long-duration storage alongside batteries", which value is closest to the continuous discharge hours of 350 GWh at 2,200 MW?
quiz.explanation: t = E / P；代入 E = 350 GWh、P = 2200 MW，得 159 h（350 GWh 蓄能量在 2,200 MW 下的連續放電時數）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = E / P; with E = 350 GWh, P = 2200 MW the result is 159 h (continuous discharge hours of 350 GWh at 2,200 MW). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 長時儲能與電池的分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-duration storage alongside batteries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長時儲能與電池的分工」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Long-duration storage alongside batteries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = E / P；代入 E = 350 GWh、P = 2200 MW，得 159 h（350 GWh 蓄能量在 2,200 MW 下的連續放電時數）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 E 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = E / P; with E = 350 GWh, P = 2200 MW the result is 159 h (continuous discharge hours of 350 GWh at 2,200 MW). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise E by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：E 增加 10% 時，結果變為 175 h（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising E by 10% changes the result to 175 h (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 159 h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 E 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 159 h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in E with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = E / P；代入 E = 350 GWh、P = 2200 MW，得 159 h（350 GWh 蓄能量在 2,200 MW 下的連續放電時數）。
knowledge.textEn: t = E / P; with E = 350 GWh, P = 2200 MW the result is 159 h (continuous discharge hours of 350 GWh at 2,200 MW).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: E 增加 10% 時，結果變為 175 h（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising E by 10% changes the result to 175 h (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長時儲能與電池的分工」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-duration storage alongside batteries"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以多年逐時的風光出力與負載資料模擬「連續低風低日照」事件的持續時間與缺電量，檢核不同時長儲能的填補比例。
水在隧道裡流動幾乎沒有損失，隧道長短不影響效率。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Simulate the duration and energy shortfall of sustained low-wind, low-sun events from multi-year hourly wind, solar and demand data, and check how much each storage duration can fill.
Water flows through a tunnel almost without loss, so tunnel length does not affect efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 以多年逐時的風光出力與負載資料模擬「連續低風低日照」事件的持續時間與缺電量，檢核不同時長儲能的填補比例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Simulate the duration and energy shortfall of sustained low-wind, low-sun events from multi-year hourly wind, solar and demand data, and check how much each storage duration can fill. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長時儲能與電池的分工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-duration storage alongside batteries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長時儲能與電池的分工」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-duration storage alongside batteries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多年逐時的風光出力與負載資料模擬「連續低風低日照」事件的持續時間與缺電量，檢核不同時長儲能的填補比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Simulate the duration and energy shortfall of sustained low-wind, low-sun events from multi-year hourly wind, solar and demand data, and check how much each storage duration can fill. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：系統規劃要分別訂定短時與長時儲能的需求量，並以極端天氣年而非平均年檢核供電可靠度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: System planning should set separate requirements for short- and long-duration storage and test reliability against extreme-weather years, not average ones.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以每日一次循環的套利收益評估，長時儲能幾乎永遠不划算；其價值在少數幾次長時缺電事件中才顯現，容易被低估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Judged only by daily arbitrage, long-duration storage almost never pays; its value appears in a few long shortfall events and is easily underestimated. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以多年逐時的風光出力與負載資料模擬「連續低風低日照」事件的持續時間與缺電量，檢核不同時長儲能的填補比例。
knowledge.textEn: Simulate the duration and energy shortfall of sustained low-wind, low-sun events from multi-year hourly wind, solar and demand data, and check how much each storage duration can fill.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 系統規劃要分別訂定短時與長時儲能的需求量，並以極端天氣年而非平均年檢核供電可靠度。
knowledge.textEn: System planning should set separate requirements for short- and long-duration storage and test reliability against extreme-weather years, not average ones.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60041 水力機械現場驗收試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60041 Field acceptance tests to determine the hydraulic performance of hydraulic machines. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「長時儲能與電池的分工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-duration storage alongside batteries" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
若只以每日一次循環的套利收益評估，長時儲能幾乎永遠不划算；其價值在少數幾次長時缺電事件中才顯現，容易被低估。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
Judged only by daily arbitrage, long-duration storage almost never pays; its value appears in a few long shortfall events and is easily underestimated.
quiz.explanation: 若只以每日一次循環的套利收益評估，長時儲能幾乎永遠不划算；其價值在少數幾次長時缺電事件中才顯現，容易被低估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Judged only by daily arbitrage, long-duration storage almost never pays; its value appears in a few long shortfall events and is easily underestimated. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長時儲能與電池的分工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-duration storage alongside batteries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長時儲能與電池的分工」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Long-duration storage alongside batteries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以每日一次循環的套利收益評估，長時儲能幾乎永遠不划算；其價值在少數幾次長時缺電事件中才顯現，容易被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「雪山 2.0 抽蓄水電工程」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Judged only by daily arbitrage, long-duration storage almost never pays; its value appears in a few long shortfall events and is easily underestimated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Snowy 2.0 Pumped Hydro Project”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩者在電力系統中的角色互補而非競爭。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The two play complementary, not competing, roles.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲能電站只要功率夠大就好，能存幾小時並不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A storage plant only needs enough power; how many hours it stores hardly matters." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以每日一次循環的套利收益評估，長時儲能幾乎永遠不划算；其價值在少數幾次長時缺電事件中才顯現，容易被低估。
knowledge.textEn: Judged only by daily arbitrage, long-duration storage almost never pays; its value appears in a few long shortfall events and is easily underestimated.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
